# cJSON

The JSON of C applications generated by Clarity: [cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON)
1.7.18, the files `cJSON.c` and `cJSON.h` of that release, unchanged, under
its MIT license (LICENSE). Every generated C project carries this copy, so
it needs no JSON package of the system. The runtime points cJSON's memory at
its scratch arena (`clarity/core.h`), so JSON is never freed by hand.
